g.text: 1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETERS UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED.
2. STRUCTURAL MATERIAL: Ti-6Al-4V / AL 2195 / CFRP COMPOSITES.
3. PRESSURE VESSELS CERTIFIED TO 1.5x OPERATING PRESSURE.
4. SURFACE FINISH: Ra 3.2μm MINIMUM FOR EXTERNAL PANELS.
5. FLIGHT HARDWARE SUBJECT TO QA VERIFICATION PER NASA-STD-8739.
